verdict.rationale: OpenCode's documentation only describes a permission system that gates or approves individual actions (opencode-docs-13/14/26/27) — this is an approval/guardrail mechanism, not an isolated sandbox environment for code execution, tool calls, or network access. No evidence describes containerized, VM-based, or otherwise isolated execution of the agent's actions; in fact community reports note the opencode serve mode has no authentication and can let any local process or webpage execute code (opencode-comm-18), the opposite of sandboxed isolation. missing for 10: any documented sandbox/container/VM isolation for code execution, network-restricted execution, or filesystem isolation mechanism.
